product: VK2735, a dual GLP-1/GIP agonist in subcutaneous and oral forms, for obesity (Phase 3 VANQUISH-1 and VANQUISH-2). Earlier pipeline: VK3019 amylin/DACRA (Phase 1), VK2809 for NASH/NAFLD, VK0214 for X-ALD (2026-07-29, primary).
demand: Pre-revenue, no product price or volume yet; growth is clinical progression plus financing. 2026-09-24 (primary): 7,857,143 shares at $35.00 (about $275M) plus $225M of 2.00% converts due 2032 at a conversion price of about $50.75, $500M total, settling 2026-09-25.
pricing_power: No product margin exists yet; the real risk is clinical or regulatory failure (a VANQUISH 78-week miss or oral Phase 3 failure) that forces more dilution, and eventual GLP-1 price competition compressing obesity drug economics (reasoned from 2026-07-29 and 2026-09-24, primary).
competition: Likely over time: cheaper GLP-1s including generics, and Chinese oral incretin developers, could undercut. No specific dated Chinese competitor was found in the sources read on 2026-09-27 - not found.
market_strategy: Brian Lian, 2026-07-29 (primary): oral VK2735 Phase 3 initiation expected to begin in the fourth quarter of this year; maintenance study results expected later this quarter (3Q26); VANQUISH-1 and VANQUISH-2 fully enrolled and proceeding according to plan.
bull: VK2735 maintenance topline 2026-09-22 (primary 8-K) showed 22% placebo-adjusted weight loss at Week 33 with up to 97% retention on every-other-week dosing; $500M raise at $35.00 (2026-09-24) funds Phase 3.
bear: Pre-revenue with no product margin; oral Phase 3 not started as of 2026-09-27; $500M dilution at $35.00 plus converts; 21-session momentum 3.4% but 63-session -6.5%; mean target $94.61 is a closed perverse signal.
falsifier: By 2026-12-31, no oral VK2735 Phase 3 initiation announced on Viking IR, per the company's own 2026-07-29 guidance.

web_did_they_deliver: Yes on maintenance: promised for 3Q26 on 2026-07-29 (primary) and delivered positive topline on 2026-09-22 (primary). Pending on oral: the promised 4Q26 Phase 3 initiation had not been announced as of 2026-09-27.
